app.title: Emitting metadata early makes building/checking Rust up to twice as fast
app.author: knuckleheads
app.description: A Rust build tool that emits metadata early to accelerate compile and check times
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and run `cargo test` to confirm build passes
Measure `cargo build` time with and without the tool enabled
Run `cargo bench` and compare benchmark results
Integrate into a CI pipeline and verify build duration reduction
